scope: The exterior of Roskilde Cathedral in July 2019, including the Gothic brick basilica, paired west spires, central spire, rounded apse, transept porches and principal attached chapels. The adjacent memorial chapel is included as site context.

originalReview.notes: Close exterior view of the brick apse, clerestory and pointed crossing spire, with a side chapel in the foreground.
Exterior of the rounded east end, tall transept with arched window, stepped brick porch and slender crossing spire.

quallaSearch.notes: Both exact Qualla exterior originals match their sole Commons uploads byte for byte. Sintakso photographed and uploaded both as own work and provided a CC0 dedication. The sarcophagus and memorial stone photographs do not show the building exterior.
